name: ONNX Runtime NNAPI Execution Provider documentation
notes: Documents the NNAPI Execution Provider as accelerating ONNX models on Android via the Android Neural Networks API, 'a unified interface to CPU, GPU, and NN accelerators on Android'. Requirements section: the EP requires Android 8.1 or higher, with Android 9 or higher recommended for optimal performance. Covers install, build, usage, configuration options and a supported-ops list. Note the documentation page still describes NNAPI as current without mentioning the Android 15 deprecation, so the docs lag the platform status.
